sut.name: bookinfo
sut.deploy: SPECIFIED: k8s with Istio sidecars + Jaeger; the productpage flow with ratings scaled to zero. Not currently deployed (bookinfo scaled to 0 for the TrainTicket tenancy window).

readback.locator: no durable read-back (nominal: this is a read-path degradation, no write is intended); the discriminator is the trace, not durable state.

config.note: ratings made unavailable (scale-to-zero or toxiproxy). The reviews service catches the failed ratings call and degrades by design.

ground_truth.label: negative
ground_truth.rationale: Designed graceful degradation: the reviews service catches a failed ratings call and productpage still returns HTTP 200 with 'Ratings service is currently unavailable' (developer-intended, istio/istio PR #15489). The downstream error span is real, but the entry behaviour is correct-by-design, so this is benign - the canonical false-positive trap for any naive 'error span under a 2xx' oracle.

provenance.notes: Stratum-2 benign trap. SPECIFIED design-target (bookinfo scaled to 0 -> not captured; these oracle_expectation values are the intended-instrumented expectation per freeze R2, NOT a measured result). REVIEW-CORPUS R4 (A-M3/C-F3) corrections: (1) FACTUAL FIX -- with ratings scaled to zero the ratings SERVER span is ABSENT (only the erroring reviews->ratings client span exists); the prior note 'the ratings span IS present' was wrong. (2) HONEST tracetest_presence=flag: a presence-assertion on the expected downstream-effect span FALSE-POSITIVES here just like naive_span_error (both are purely structural: an error/absence under a 2xx). So on this pair naive AND tracetest_presence BOTH FP -- neither separates benign from genuine. (3) The ONLY discriminating column is mist_trace_shape (design-target no_flag): MIST must encode the SEMANTIC discriminator that ratings is a CONTRACTUALLY-OPTIONAL read with NO required durable downstream effect (istio PR #15489; the entry response even communicates the degradation, 'Ratings service is currently unavailable'), whereas sockshop's lost shipping task IS a required durable effect. (4) mist_readback=not_applicable (none-durable). This precision advantage is a PRE-REGISTERED claim validated on live capture of the bookinfo/sockshop pair, not a pilot result. rev-2 migration: readback modality none-durable + expect pair NOMINAL (R11: no durable write on this read-path degradation; the enum has no no-write value); mist_dataintegrity_oracle -> mist_readback_oracle. R12: ack_content_visibility=success-shaped-clean is w.r.t. the MACHINE tell (no status field / sentinel -> body_marker=no_flag); the 'Ratings unavailable' string is human-readable HTML prose, available to a semantic oracle (that is discriminator (3)) but not a machine sentinel a substring body oracle keys on.
